name: Calista
source:
Princess Calista is a forlorn soul bound to an old abandoned manor, sad and alone she spends her nights spooking the people of the city. Will someone manage to find the source of her despair and bring her back to the light?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1806280/Leap_of_Love__Dark_Princesses/]Steam[/url]]
